title: Purple Mountain Sky Overlay
description: Minecraft skybox with a mix of purples and blues!
body:
**Pack Overview:**

This resource pack replaces the sky with an image of a purple mountain that has contrasting shades on each side of the mountain!

**Requirements:**

For this resource pack to perform properly, you must use Optifine or any other mods that allow custom skies.

**Minecraft Settings:**

Custom skies: On

Sky: Off

**_If skybox doesn't work, relaunch Minecraft_**
